summary_en: 100% acquisition of Wakayanagi Kasei Kogyo for ¥200M (shares) + ¥35M advisory fees. Target manufactures livestock-farming equipment (feed tanks, containers, septic tanks). Board approved 7 August 2026; stock transfer expected 31 August 2026. Expected consolidation from Q2 FY3/27; minimal impact on FY3/27 group earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice of Stock Acquisition of Wakayanagi Kasei Kogyo Co., Ltd. (Making It a Wholly Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: Chugoku Kogyo announced on 7 August 2026 that its board has approved the acquisition of 100% of Wakayanagi Kasei Kogyo Co., Ltd., a manufacturer of livestock-farming equipment including feed tanks, feed containers, and septic tanks. Chugoku Kogyo has received stable, high-quality materials from the target company for many years within its facilities-equipment business segment. The acquisition aims to enhance service quality and operational efficiency. The purchase price is ¥200 million for the ordinary shares, plus ¥35 million in advisory fees (which includes retiring director severance). The stock transfer is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Wakayanagi Kasei will be consolidated into Chugoku Kogyo's financial statements from the second quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027; the company expects minimal impact on FY3/27 group earnings guidance.
